problem.title: Public demand is visible. Decision-ready context is not.
problem.body: Opportunities sit across portals, languages, amendments, documents and deadlines. Teams rebuild the same context by hand, then make a bid/no-bid call before they can test every assumption.
items: Different portals, formats, taxonomies and update rhythms.
Eligibility, fit, timing and evidence are reviewed repeatedly.
Source changes and contradictions disappear into tabs and spreadsheets.

storyIntro.title: From a procurement question to an evidence-linked dossier.
storyIntro.body: Scroll through one synthetic product demonstration. Source states reflect the repository catalogue, not marketed coverage.

acts.title: Start with the scattered public record.
acts.body: AXIGNAL keeps portals, notices, documents and updates separate until their provenance and lifecycle can be tested.

acts.title: Ask a commercial question, not a keyword query.
acts.body: Describe the capability, countries, buyer profile and constraints. Navigator creates a typed, reversible investigation context.

acts.title: See where demand, fit and evidence intersect.
acts.body: The Globe separates the admitted TED pilot profile from discovery systems and unavailable coverage. Visual intensity never changes admission state.
acts.detail: TED bounded profile · private authenticated pilot

acts.title: Qualify the opportunity before committing bid resources.
acts.body: A dossier keeps scope, buyer, deadlines, eligibility, documents, amendments and unknowns in one reviewable object.

acts.title: Separate what is observed from what is inferred.
acts.body: Every material conclusion carries a type, source reference, freshness, transformation and counter-evidence state.

acts.title: AI can propose. The runtime decides what enters the ledger.
acts.body: Deterministic validators reject malformed or unsupported candidates. Contradictions and unknowns remain visible.

acts.title: Move from search effort to governed bid decisions.
acts.body: Reuse the investigation, assign review, monitor material changes and preserve the reasoning behind a bid/no-bid decision.

acts.title: Validate the workflow with one expensive procurement problem.
acts.body: Design Partner access is reviewed for organisations willing to test a bounded workflow and provide structured evidence.
acts.detail: Applications only · no billing or subscription enabled

outcomes.title: Measure saved research effort without inventing ROI.
outcomes.body: The calculator uses only the values you enter. It is a planning aid, not a performance claim.
outcomes.note: Illustrative estimate = opportunities × hours × assumed reduction × hourly cost. It excludes win rate, revenue, implementation cost and quality effects.

pricing.title: Professional pricing, tested before it is frozen.
pricing.body: Design Partner is a special validation programme. Controlled trial and paid-plan applications are visible; public activation, checkout and automatic conversion remain disabled.
plans: Bounded workflow validation, direct product feedback and preferential candidate terms.
Individual investigation, dossiers, monitoring and evidence exports.
Shared investigations, review workflow, governance and expanded usage.
Security, integration, support, data and API obligations scoped by contract.

faq.title: What the current landing does—and does not—promise.
items: Does AXIGNAL cover procurement globally today?
No. The repository contains a worldwide research catalogue, but no global coverage claim is authorised. Sources advance independently through admission.
Is TED available in the product?
The bounded TED Search API product profile is admitted for the private authenticated pilot. Public access and unrestricted source use remain disabled.
Does AXIGNAL write or submit bids?
No. AXIGNAL supports research, qualification and investigation. It does not submit procurement responses or make final decisions.
No. Design Partner and plan ranges are candidate commercial hypotheses that require paid evidence.

A controlled 7-day trial is application-only while public trial access remains disabled. Approved organisations receive 1,000,000 cumulative tokens, no card, no renewal or overage, and read-only access at expiry.
